name: SiteRoyal – AI Site Manager
author: SwiftlyWP

sections.description:
SiteRoyal connects your WordPress and WooCommerce site to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Manage your entire site through natural language conversations — no manual clicking through wp-admin. Works with any MCP-compatible AI client.

What You Can Do

WordPress Management:
* Create, edit, and manage posts and pages
* Organize categories and tags
* Upload media from URLs
* Moderate comments
* Check plugins, themes, and site health
* Search across all content

WooCommerce Store Management:
* List, create, and update products with full details
* Bulk update prices, stock, and status for multiple products
* View and manage orders, update statuses, add notes
* List customers and their order history
* Create and manage coupons (percentage, fixed, free shipping)
* Get sales reports, top products, and low stock alerts
* Manage product variations, categories, and attributes
* View shipping zones, payment gateways, and tax rates

Works With

  • Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible AI client
  • Desktop AI apps, browser-based AI assistants, and CLI tools
  • See our documentation for setup guides for popular AI clients

Security First

  • Admin-only access — Editors and below are blocked
  • Credentials encrypted with AES-256-GCM
  • Delete operations go to trash (never permanent)
  • New posts and products default to draft status
  • All AI actions logged in activity log
  • Uses WordPress Application Passwords (same as Jetpack)

Free to Start

The Starter plan is free forever with 50 daily AI tool calls and access to all read + basic write tools. Upgrade to Pro, Business, or Agency for bulk operations, advanced WooCommerce management, SEO tools, and higher limits. No credit card required to get started.

External Service

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the SwiftlyMCP relay server hosted at swiftlymcp.com. The relay server acts as a bridge between your site and MCP-compatible AI assistants.

What data is transmitted:
* Your site URL and WordPress REST API responses (posts, pages, products, etc.) as requested by your AI assistant
* An Application Password (encrypted with AES-256-GCM) stored on the relay server to authenticate API requests
* Activity logs of AI-initiated actions

When data is transmitted:
* Only when you actively use an AI assistant connected via SiteRoyal
* No data is sent in the background or without user interaction

Links:
* SwiftlyMCP Terms of Service
* SwiftlyMCP Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload siteroyal-ai-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Add the SwiftlyMCP server URL to your AI client
  4. Sign in with your email
  5. Authorize the connection from your wp-admin
  6. Start managing your site with AI!
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! SiteRoyal has deep WooCommerce integration with 25+ store management tools. It automatically detects WooCommerce and enables product, order, customer, coupon, and reporting tools.

Is this free?

The Starter plan is free forever with generous daily limits. Paid plans (Pro, Business, Agency) unlock bulk operations, advanced tools, and higher limits. No credit card required to start.

Is it safe?

Yes. SiteRoyal uses WordPress Application Passwords (the same auth method used by Jetpack and the WordPress mobile app), encrypts all credentials with AES-256-GCM, and restricts access to administrators only. All AI actions are logged in an audit trail.

Does the AI have access to my password?

No. Credentials are encrypted and never passed through AI conversations. The AI only sees the results of API calls, not your login details.
